'''Agricultural loading platform XT-21s''' was located seventeen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] outside [[Thulpin City]] on [[Draenell's Point]]. During the [[Battle of Bissillirus]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces raided the platform for its [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies.
